description: Snapped off at the root, cream shading to brown. The Diretusk it belonged to never broke stride.
lore: A whole tusk fetches four times what a broken one does, and there is a man on the north market road who makes up the difference with bone glue, a lathe and thirty years of practice. The join sits under the curve, where a buyer's thumb never goes. He has sold mended tusks to people who have handled tusks their whole span, and one of them was [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun]], who spotted it at the door on her way out, went back in, and bought a second one to work out how he had done it.

She has never said a word about him to anyone on that road. He is also the only buyer at that market who pays a new cracker the real price for a first bag rather than what a frightened person will take. Everybody there knows both halves of this. The market runs on it, cheerfully, and has for years.
gm_notes: The batch's joke that turns into a moral. A known forger protected by the trade because he is the fairest buyer in it; Sigrun is the only one who can see the work and the only one who has to stay quiet.
